articles.title: Accelebot turns your iPhone into a tilt-controlled platformer you can play one-handed
articles.summary: You don’t get a single button in Accelebot. No d-pad, no jump icon parked in the corner, nothing. You tilt your iPhone to move, tap anywhere on the screen to jump, and that’s the whole control scheme, playable one-handed in portrait. It’s a 2D platformer, and it’s out now on the App Store. It comes from solo developer Robert Perez. The levels are large, with secrets tucked away for anyone who goes poking around. The level select screen keeps track of which ones you’ve found. Each level also logs your total time, so you can chase your own best or the developer’s, and there’s a quick menu for switching off the sound effects and music without leaving a level.
